title: Upgrade precheck inventory (WIP) — Private upgrades
content:
Notes (WIP)
- Purpose: single inventory of upgrade preflight checks for Redwood Private (VPC + on-prem/air-gapped). Used to drive ENG-4829 scope + release gating.
- Precheck engine: installer framework (PR-4834). Output states: PASS | WARN | BLOCK. (BLOCK must prevent upgrade plan execution unless overridden with explicit flag + reason.)
- Defaults (proposal): Security/compliance + data-loss risks are BLOCK. Capacity/latency risks are WARN unless clearly upgrade-fatal.
- Columns: Severity = BLOCK/WARN/INFO (where INFO means “log only / advisory”). Status values are rough: Not started | In progress | Implemented | In beta | Needs spec | Needs owner.
- Owner = “accountable” engineer/team; implementation may involve multiple repos.

Legend
- Applies_to: VPC | OnPrem | Both
- Where: Installer | Helm | Terraform | Control-plane | Docs/Process
- Remediation: should be phrased as what the operator can do in the moment.

Last review (informal): 2025-06-14 (SRE + Release Eng sync). Open question: which OIDC/SSO checks are BLOCK by default for air-gapped w/ local auth.

TABLE (inventory)
| ID | Category | Precheck | Applies_to | Severity | Owner | Status | Where | Detection (what we test) | Remediation (operator guidance) | Notes / refs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PC-001 | Versioning | Supported upgrade path (N-1 → N) | Both | BLOCK | Quentin Harris | Implemented | Control-plane + Installer | Evaluate target version vs current using compatibility policy; block unsupported jumps | Choose a supported target (or do intermediate upgrade); contact support for exceptions | GitHub redwood/pr-29104; aligns w GA non-goal re multi-hop |
| PC-002 | Artifacts | Upgrade artifacts resolvable (charts/images/binaries) | Both | BLOCK | Connor O'Brien | In beta | Installer | Validate all required artifacts exist for target version and are reachable from environment | Fix artifact source (registry/repo/mirror), re-run with --plan-only to confirm | Installer plan generator PR-4821 + preflight PR-4834 |
| PC-003 | Air-gapped | Offline bundle manifest + checksums/signature valid | OnPrem | BLOCK | Fatima Noor | Implemented | Installer | Verify bundle manifest, sha256, and signature (if enabled) | Re-download bundle; confirm correct bundle version; re-run bundle verify command | PR-4871; Support ticket SUP-18510 |
| PC-004 | Kubernetes | Supported Kubernetes version | Both | BLOCK | Irene Choi | In progress | Installer + Docs | Query server version; compare to support matrix | Upgrade Kubernetes or pick compatible Redwood version | Needs explicit matrix in docs + CI matrix alignment |
| PC-005 | Kubernetes | Cluster reachable + auth works (kubeconfig) | Both | BLOCK | Bruno Silva | Implemented | Installer | `kubectl version` + list namespaces + list nodes | Fix kubeconfig/context; ensure RBAC for installer service account | Common “wrong context” failure mode |
| PC-006 | Cluster health | Nodes Ready / basic scheduling health | Both | BLOCK | Sean Gallagher | In beta | Installer | Ensure nodes are Ready; no critical kube-system CrashLoopBackOff (coredns/metrics-server optional) | Stabilize cluster; resolve node NotReady; drain/replace failing nodes | Define “critical” components list (WIP) |
| PC-007 | Capacity | CPU/memory headroom for control-plane upgrade jobs | Both | WARN | Sean Gallagher | Needs spec | Installer | Estimate requested resources for upgrade jobs; compare to allocatable - current usage | Scale nodegroup / add capacity; schedule maintenance window | Make deterministic: use configured request/limits in chart |
| PC-008 | Storage | Persistent volume headroom (PVC usage + underlying volume) | Both | BLOCK | Irene Choi | Implemented | Installer | Check PV/PVC capacity + usage (where available) and underlying storage free space; require >= X% headroom | Expand volume, prune logs, increase retention settings, add storage | Support ticket SUP-18577 (insufficient storage) |
| PC-009 | Storage | Snapshot capability available for storage backend | Both | BLOCK | Irene Choi | In progress | Installer + Helm | Detect CSI snapshot CRDs/controllers (or EBS snapshot perms); ensure snapshot class configured | Install snapshot controller/CRDs; configure SnapshotClass; or choose logical backup mode | Tied to backup strategy doc; Slack eng-infra/1739390021 |
| PC-010 | Backups | Backup destination reachable + writable | Both | BLOCK | Irene Choi | Needs owner | Installer | Test write to configured backup target (S3/NFS/object store) w/ small probe | Fix network route/creds; update backup target config; retry | Also depends on customer’s KMS policy |
| PC-011 | Backups | KMS / encryption configuration present (if required) | Both | BLOCK | Marcus Lin | Needs spec | Installer + Docs | If `backup.encryption.required=true`, validate KMS key ARN/endpoint reachable and permissions OK | Provide valid KMS key; fix IAM/policy; for on-prem configure HSM/KMS integration | Align with security review call 2025-06-12 |
| PC-012 | Database | DB reachable (control-plane DB) | Both | BLOCK | Michael Nguyen | In beta | Installer | Check TCP reachability + auth; run simple query | Fix network policy/security group; rotate creds; confirm DB endpoint | Common during VPC upgrades |
| PC-013 | Database | DB migration lock timeout risk (active long transactions) | Both | WARN | Michael Nguyen | In progress | Installer + Control-plane | Inspect long-running transactions / blocking locks (where supported) | Pause heavy workloads; schedule quieter window; increase lock timeout with caution | GitHub redwood/pr-29210 migration guardrails |
| PC-014 | Database | Sufficient DB disk space / free storage | Both | BLOCK | Michael Nguyen | Needs spec | Installer | Check free space >= threshold; verify autovacuum/maintenance not failing | Increase disk; vacuum; purge old audit rows per retention | Needs DB-specific implementations |
| PC-015 | AuthN/Z | Installer has required RBAC to create jobs/hooks in namespace | Both | BLOCK | Benji Okafor | Implemented | Installer | Self-test create+delete a Job + ConfigMap + Secret (if needed) in target namespace | Apply provided ClusterRole/RoleBinding; rerun | Must not leave resources behind |
| PC-016 | AuthN/Z | OIDC/SSO reachability (if configured) | VPC | WARN | Victor Alvarez | Needs spec | Installer | Validate OIDC discovery URL reachable + TLS valid | Fix DNS/TLS; allow egress; switch to break-glass local admin for upgrade | Debate: should be BLOCK? see Slack eng/1739384982 |
| PC-017 | Networking | DNS resolution for required endpoints (registry, chart repo, OIDC, object store) | VPC | BLOCK | Victor Alvarez | In progress | Installer | Resolve hostnames from within cluster (test pod) | Fix CoreDNS, VPC DNS, private hosted zones; add necessary stub domains | For on-prem, use mirror endpoints instead |
| PC-018 | Networking | Time sync within cluster nodes (NTP drift) | Both | WARN | Rafael Mendes | Needs owner | Installer + Docs | Measure node clock skew vs reference (or check chrony status) | Fix NTP/chrony; restart time sync service | Helpful for cert validation + auth issues |
| PC-019 | TLS | Cluster trust chain includes corporate TLS intercept CA (if used) | OnPrem | WARN | Hanae Suzuki | Needs owner | Docs/Process | Detect TLS failures to registry/mirror; check config for custom CA bundle | Install CA bundle into installer + workloads; update trust config | Seen in heavily regulated on-prem |
| PC-020 | Registry | Container registry reachable + pull credentials valid | Both | BLOCK | Bruno Silva | Implemented | Installer | Attempt auth + pull of small test image from target registry (or mirror) | Fix creds; update secret; ensure egress/route to registry | Terraform PR-1340 adds mirror endpoints |
| PC-021 | Helm | Helm version supported + server-side apply compatibility | Both | WARN | Connor O'Brien | Needs spec | Installer + Docs | Check helm client version; validate capability flags used by charts | Upgrade helm; use bundled helm binary if provided | Clarify: do we ship helm with installer? |
| PC-022 | Helm | No pending/failed helm release in target namespace | Both | BLOCK | Connor O'Brien | In progress | Installer | Query helm history/status; block if release is in failed/pending state | Roll back/cleanup prior release; resolve stuck hooks; contact support if uncertain | Prevents compounding failures |
| PC-023 | Operator workflow | Maintenance window declared / change ticket present (enterprise) | Both | INFO | Talia Benson | Needs spec | Docs/Process | Optional prompt requiring change ticket ID (for audit trail) | Create change record; attach plan output | Fits change management policy; should not block by default |
| PC-024 | Observability | Metrics/logging endpoints reachable (for upgrade dashboards) | Both | WARN | Allison Grant | Needs owner | Installer + Docs | Verify Prometheus remote write / logging sink connectivity if configured | Fix connectivity; proceed but note reduced visibility | Not upgrade-fatal but affects triage |
| PC-025 | Safety | Backup completed within last N hours (if policy requires) | Both | WARN | Sean Gallagher | Needs spec | Installer | Check backup metadata; ensure recent successful backup exists | Run backup now; verify completion; then re-run upgrade | Tie to backup orchestrator PR-4850 |
| PC-026 | Safety | Sufficient permissions for snapshot APIs (cloud IAM / on-prem storage) | Both | BLOCK | Irene Choi | In progress | Installer | Attempt list/create snapshot (dry-run where possible) | Fix IAM roles or storage credentials; ensure snapshot controller installed | Split by backend: EBS vs generic CSI |
| PC-027 | Config | Custom overrides validated (values schema / forbidden settings) | Both | BLOCK | Ines Carvalho | Needs owner | Installer + Helm | Validate Helm values against schema; detect deprecated/removed keys | Update values file; remove deprecated settings; re-run plan | Prevents silent misconfig during upgrade |
| PC-028 | Config | Secrets present (required keys) + not expiring during window | Both | WARN | Hanae Suzuki | Needs spec | Installer | Validate required Secret refs exist; check cert expiry < X days | Rotate certs/secrets; extend validity; rerun | Expiring certs during upgrade = nightmare |
| PC-029 | Runtime | GPU plugin/driver health (if Dedicated GPU nodes used in Private) | Both | WARN | Irene Choi | Needs spec | Installer | Detect nvidia device plugin readiness; sample `nvidia-smi` via DaemonSet | Fix driver/plugin; postpone upgrade if impact high | Clarify whether Private always includes GPU nodes |
| PC-030 | Data plane | Control-plane connectivity to data-plane agents | Both | WARN | Ethan Park | In progress | Control-plane + Installer | Health check CP→DP endpoints; agent heartbeat fresh | Fix network policies/SGs; restart agents; ensure DNS | Needed to coordinate CP/DP phased rollout |
| PC-031 | API compatibility | Client-breaking API flags disabled during upgrade | Both | INFO | Ethan Park | Needs owner | Control-plane | Detect feature flags that require coordinated client change | Schedule follow-up release; communicate to app teams | More “policy” than “precheck” |
| PC-032 | State | Existing upgrade state not “dirty” (previous attempt unfinished) | Both | BLOCK | Rafael Mendes | In beta | Installer | Detect stored upgrade state machine in “in-progress/failed” | Run `rollback` or `resume` per guidance; attach logs to support bundle | PR-4862 rollback state machine |
| PC-033 | Security | Audit logging sink configured (if required) | Both | WARN | Kevin Osei | Needs spec | Control-plane + Docs | Validate audit events can be emitted and forwarded | Configure SIEM sink/retention; proceed with warning | Depends on enterprise requirements |
| PC-034 | Networking | Ingress/Load balancer changes allowed (policy) | VPC | WARN | Victor Alvarez | Needs spec | Installer + Docs | Detect whether upgrade would modify LB/Ingress resources; check policy setting `network.freeze=true` | Disable freeze temporarily or pre-approve LB changes; otherwise block specific steps | Some customers require explicit approval |
| PC-035 | Process | Release gating approvals recorded (SRE + Release Eng) | Both | INFO | Connor O'Brien | In progress | Docs/Process | Optional field to include approver names/timestamp in plan metadata | Get approval; attach to change record | Email thread 20250522-private-upgrade-change-management-approval |
| PC-036 | CI parity | Environment matches tested matrix (k8s/storage) | Both | WARN | Sahana Iyer | In progress | Installer + Docs | Compare k8s version + storage backend + distro to CI matrix list | If outside matrix: proceed w caution; require SRE sign-off; suggest staging rehearsal | Confluence: private-installer-integration-test-matrix |

Action items / gaps (rough)
- Decide: BLOCK vs WARN for OIDC reachability when local admin is enabled (Victor + Marcus + Sean).
- Document thresholds: storage headroom %, DB free space, “recent backup” window, time skew threshold.
- Add backend-specific implementations: CSI snapshots (generic), EBS snapshots (AWS), logical dumps fallback.
- Standardize remediation links in installer output (point to runbook anchors + support bundle instructions).

Quick mapping to operator UX (installer)
- `redwood-private upgrade plan --target <ver>` runs all BLOCK+WARN checks, produces plan artifact.
- `redwood-private upgrade run` requires all BLOCK checks PASS (unless `--override <check_id>:<reason>` with audit log).
- `redwood-private support-bundle` should include full precheck report (PASS/WARN/BLOCK + raw details).
